theory.intro: Translate a real situation into a number sentence using positive and negative integers, then evaluate it.
facts: Write the starting value, then each change in order, then evaluate.
steps: Decide what each direction means (e.g. up = +, down = −).
Write the starting value, then each change as + or −.
Rewrite touching signs and evaluate left to right.

workedExamples.question_text:
Write a number sentence and evaluate it.
(a) The temperature is $-6^{\circ}\text{C}$ and rises by $11^{\circ}\text{C}$.
(b) A diver is at $-18$ m and descends another $7$ m.
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) Below zero is negative; a rise is $+$.
$-6+11=5$
The new temperature is $5^{\circ}\text{C}$.
(b) Below the surface is negative; descending is $-$.
$-18-7=-25$
The diver is at $-25$ m.

workedExamples.question_text:
Kim owes $80$ dollars, a balance of $-80$.
(a) She repays $35$ dollars. Write a number sentence for her new balance and evaluate it.
(b) She then borrows another $25$ dollars. Find her balance.
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) A repayment reduces the debt.
$-80+35=-45$
Her balance is $-45$ dollars.
(b) Borrowing more increases the debt.
$-45-25=-70$
Her balance is $-70$ dollars; she owes $70$ dollars.

workedExamples.question_text:
Write a number sentence for each final position and evaluate it.
(a) A lift starts at floor $-2$, goes up $6$ floors, then down $9$ floors.
(b) A hiker starts at $-14$ m, climbs $33$ m, then descends $8$ m.
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) Up is $+$; down is $-$.
$-2+6-9$
$=4-9$
$=-5$
The lift reaches floor $-5$.
(b) Climbing is $+$; descending is $-$.
$-14+33-8$
$=19-8$
$=11$
The final altitude is $11$ m.

workedExamples.question_text:
Write a number sentence and evaluate it.
(a) The highest temperature is $17^{\circ}\text{C}$ and the lowest is $-9^{\circ}\text{C}$. Find the difference.
(b) A business has a loan-account balance of $-2400$ dollars. It borrows another $600$ dollars, repays $850$ dollars, then deposits $450$ dollars of profit into the loan account. Find the final balance and state how much it owes.
workedExamples.solution_text:
(a) Subtract the lower temperature from the higher.
$17-(-9)$
$=17+9$
$=26$
The difference is $26^{\circ}\text{C}$.
(b) More borrowing is $-$; repayments and deposits into the loan account are $+$.
$-2400-600+850+450$
$=-3000+850+450$
$=-2150+450$
$=-1700$
The balance is $-1700$ dollars, so the business owes $1700$ dollars.

foundation.question_text:
The temperature was $-4^{\circ}\text{C}$.
It rose by $9^{\circ}\text{C}$.
Write a number sentence for the new temperature and evaluate it.
foundation.solution_text:
Below zero is negative; a rise is $+$.
$-4 + 9$
$= 5$
The new temperature is $5^{\circ}\text{C}$.

foundation.question_text: A diver is $15$ m below the surface, at $-15$ m. She descends another $8$ m. Write a number sentence for her new depth and evaluate it.
foundation.solution_text:
Below the surface is negative; descending is $-$.
$-15 - 8$
$= -23$
She is at $-23$ m.

foundation.question_text:
Kim owes the bank \$300, a balance of $-300$.
She pays back \$120.
Write a number sentence for her new balance and evaluate it.
foundation.solution_text:
Owing money is negative; a repayment is $+$.
$-300 + 120$
$= -180$
Her balance is $-\$180$.

foundation.question_text:
A lift starts $4$ floors below ground, at $-4$.
It goes up $8$ floors.
Write a number sentence for the floor it reaches and evaluate it.
foundation.solution_text:
Below ground is negative; going up is $+$.
$-4 + 8$
$= 4$
The lift reaches floor $4$.

foundation.question_text:
The temperature was $3^{\circ}\text{C}$.
It fell by $6^{\circ}\text{C}$.
Write a number sentence for the new temperature and evaluate it.
foundation.solution_text:
A fall is $-$.
$3 - 6$
$= -3$
The new temperature is $-3^{\circ}\text{C}$.

foundation.question_text:
A submarine is at $-100$ m, that is $100$ m below sea level.
It is raised by $41$ m. Write a number sentence for its new position and evaluate it.
foundation.solution_text:
Below sea level is negative; being raised is $+$.
$-100 + 41$
$= -59$
It is at $-59$ m.

foundation.question_text:
Sam owes \$85, a balance of $-85$.
He borrows another \$220.
Write a number sentence for what he owes and evaluate it.
foundation.solution_text:
Owing money is negative; borrowing more is $-$.
$-85 - 220$
$= -305$
He owes \$305, a balance of $-\$305$.

foundation.question_text:
A player's score is $-2$ points.
She then loses another $5$ points.
Write a number sentence for her new score and evaluate it.
foundation.solution_text:
Losing points is $-$.
$-2 - 5$
$= -7$
Her score is $-7$ points.

development.question_text:
From ground level ($0$), a lift went down $3$ floors, then up $5$ floors, then down $4$ floors.
Write a number sentence for its final floor and evaluate it.
A submarine at sea level ($0$) dived $50$ m, then dived another $26$ m, then rose $32$ m. Write a number sentence for its final position and evaluate it.

In one town the highest recorded temperature is $35^{\circ}\text{C}$ and the lowest is $-26^{\circ}\text{C}$.
Write a number sentence for the difference between them and evaluate it.
development.solution_text:
The difference is the higher minus the lower.
$35 - (-26)$
$= 35 + 26$
$= 61$
The difference is $61^{\circ}\text{C}$.

development.question_text: A mountain peak is $3776$ m above sea level and a nearby lake is at $-4$ m. Write a number sentence for the height difference between them and evaluate it.
development.solution_text:
The difference is the higher minus the lower.
$3776 - (-4)$
$= 3776 + 4$
$= 3780$
The difference is $3780$ m.

development.question_text:

You earn \$420 and pay back the debt.

mastery.question_text:
A business takes out a \$50000 loan, a debt of $-50000$.
It later adds \$20000 to the loan, then repays \$12000, then deposits \$15000 into the loan account.
Write a number sentence for the amount owed and evaluate it.
mastery.solution_text:
A loan and adding to it are negative; a repayment and a deposit are $+$.
$-50000 - 20000 + 12000 + 15000$
$= -70000 + 12000 + 15000$
$= -58000 + 15000$
$= -43000$
The business owes \$43000.

mastery.question_text:
A hiker starts in a valley at $-30$ m, that is $30$ m below sea level.
She climbs $250$ m to a ridge, descends $80$ m, then climbs another $120$ m. Write a number sentence for her final altitude and evaluate it.
mastery.solution_text:
Below sea level is negative; climbing is $+$; descending is $-$.
$-30 + 250 - 80 + 120$
$= 220 - 80 + 120$
$= 140 + 120$
$= 260$
Her altitude is $260$ m.

mastery.question_text:
A bank account starts at \$120.
There is a purchase of \$200, then a deposit of \$150, then a \$95 fee.
Write a number sentence for the final balance and evaluate it.
mastery.solution_text:
The opening balance is $+$; a purchase and a fee are $-$; a deposit is $+$.
$120 - 200 + 150 - 95$
$= -80 + 150 - 95$
$= 70 - 95$
$= -25$
The balance is $-\$25$.

mastery.question_text:
At dawn the temperature was $-8^{\circ}\text{C}$.
It rose $12^{\circ}\text{C}$ by noon, fell $5^{\circ}\text{C}$ by evening, then fell another $6^{\circ}\text{C}$ overnight.
Write a number sentence for the overnight temperature and evaluate it.
mastery.solution_text:
Below zero is negative; a rise is $+$; a fall is $-$.
$-8 + 12 - 5 - 6$
$= 4 - 5 - 6$
$= -1 - 6$
$= -7$
The overnight temperature is $-7^{\circ}\text{C}$.
